name: infomemory-agent
description: Security-first enterprise information memory agent for Feishu and desktop workflows.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @infomemory/core && npm run build --workspace @infomemory/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @infomemory/core && npm run typecheck --workspace @infomemory/api
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @infomemory/core && npm run test --workspace @infomemory/api
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
